$comment: The key set every brand's strings.is.json must provide, exactly. Code references these keys only, never a brand's text. A value is either a whole sentence (a string) or, when plural is true, an object with the Icelandic CLDR categories one and other. Placeholders are written {name} and must match the declared set in every brand. A placeholder never carries the brand name: the name inflects, so each brand writes its own whole sentences (docs/decisions/0004).

app_name.description: Launcher label, home-screen name, store-facing display name.

tab_me.description: Bottom tab: own profile, invite link and the way to settings (docs/decisions/0034).

new_conversation.description: Action that starts a new conversation.

conversations_empty.description: The conversation list when there is none yet; points at the invite link (docs/decisions/0022).

conversations_catching_up.description: The conversation list of a browser or an app that has not yet caught up with what the server owed it (docs/decisions/0108).

conversations_search.description: Placeholder of the name search under the conversation list header; it finds conversations and people by the start of a name (docs/decisions/0038).

conversations_people.description: Heading over the people the conversation list's search found in the directory, below the conversations it found (docs/decisions/0036).

conversations_pick.description: The conversation pane beside the list on an expanded window while none is open (docs/decisions/0093).

conversations_none_found.description: The conversation list's search when neither a conversation nor a person matches it.

people_empty.description: The new-conversation picker when nobody else has signed in yet; points at the invite link (docs/decisions/0022, 0036).

people_search.description: Placeholder of the name search at the top of the new-conversation picker (docs/decisions/0036).

people_none_found.description: The new-conversation picker when no signed-in account's name matches the search (docs/decisions/0036).

people_met.description: Heading over the people met through shared conversations in the new-conversation picker.

people_everyone.description: Heading over everyone else signed in, in the new-conversation picker (docs/decisions/0036).

connection_offline.description: Line on the conversation list while the app has no connection to the server (docs/decisions/0022).

connection_connecting.description: Line on the conversation list while the app reconnects.

conversation_removed_banner.description: Banner in a conversation this account was removed from; the conversation is read-only (docs/decisions/0022).

conversation_alone_banner.description: Banner in a conversation no other account is in any more, as a 1:1 after a block; nothing can be sent there (docs/decisions/0024).

conversation_alone_title.description: Title of a conversation no other account is in any more; a conversation is otherwise titled by its members (docs/decisions/0022).

conversation_excluded_banner.description: Banner in a conversation the server refuses this device for; read-only until the next try (docs/decisions/0020, 0022).

conversation_stale_banner.description: Banner while this device rejoins a conversation it fell behind in (docs/decisions/0021, 0022).

contact_action.description: Button on an invite landing that opens a conversation with the inviter.

invite.description: Share your own invite link or QR code (docs/decisions/0009).

history_load_older.description: Button above a conversation's messages: load the older ones.

message_sending.description: Status of an own message that is still being sent.

message_failed.description: Status of an own message that could not be sent; the bubble offers try_again.

verified_with_kennitala.description: Badge on a person verified through Kenni.

verified_short.description: Short form of verified_with_kennitala, under the other person's name at the top of a conversation.

last_line_own.description: The conversation list's preview line when the newest message is the reader's own.

last_line_sender.description: The conversation list's preview line in a group when the newest message is someone else's; name is the sender's first name.

push_fallback_body.description: Notification text when the device could not fetch what a push announced: the APNs alert the notification service extension keeps when it cannot decrypt in time, and Android's when its sync fails (docs/decisions/0025). Never names the sender.

notification_channel_social_name.description: Android notification channel for community notifications: comments, replies and reactions (decision 0107).

notification_channel_social_description.description: Description of the community notifications channel in Android settings (decision 0107).

notification_you.description: The reader in a message notification's conversation style; Android requires a name for them, though it rarely shows it (docs/decisions/0025).

notifications_off.description: Row on Ég when the system blocks the app's notifications: new messages are not announced until it is opened (docs/decisions/0025).

notifications_settings.description: Action on the notifications_off row: opens the app's notification settings in the system.

new_device_card.description: System card in a conversation when a member adds a device (from an MLS add commit).

member_added_card.description: System card when an account joins a group (docs/decisions/0022).

member_removed_card.description: System card when an account leaves a group, is removed, or deletes its account (docs/decisions/0022).

member_removed_card_direct.description: System card in a 1:1 when the other account leaves it, as on a block; member_removed_card says the same of a group (docs/decisions/0022).

history_device_local_notice.description: Explains that a new device sees only messages sent after it joined (docs/decisions/0006).

invite_link_title.description: Heading of the screen with the user's own invite link and QR code.

invite_link_hint.description: Explains what the invite link does.

invite_link_rotate.description: Replace the invite link; the old one stops working.

link_invited_by.description: Heading of the invite link page (/l/{token}) and of the app's invite screen when a person sent the link (docs/decisions/0019).

link_invited.description: Heading of the invite link page and of the app's invite screen when the operator sent the link, or the inviter has no name.

link_open_in_app.description: Button on the invite link page that opens the invite in the app.

link_test_group.description: Invite link page: the app is in a closed test, and how to get it.

link_expired.description: The invite link page and the app's invite screen for a link that was rotated, revoked or never existed.

update_required_title.description: Heading of the screen shown once the server no longer serves this build (docs/decisions/0030).

update_required_body.description: The update screen: this build is too old, and installing the newest one lets the person go on.

update_required_action.description: Button on the update screen that opens the app's store page.

update_url_android.description: Default URL opened by the Android update screen.

new_group.description: Action that starts a new group.

attach.description: Attach a photo or file to a message.

attachment_remove.description: Removes the photo or file waiting above the composer; nothing is sent (docs/decisions/0048).

caption_placeholder.description: The empty composer while a photo or file waits above it; its text is sent as the caption (docs/decisions/0048).

attachment_pending_photo.description: Screen reader label of the photo waiting above the composer (docs/decisions/0048).

attachment_pending_file.description: Screen reader label of the file waiting above the composer; name is the file's name (docs/decisions/0048).

camera.description: Composer button that takes a photo with the system camera (docs/decisions/0047).

camera_usage.description: Why the app asks for the camera, shown by iOS in its permission prompt (NSCameraUsageDescription, docs/decisions/0047).

location.description: A location message (docs/decisions/0059): the attach menu's choice, the card's heading, the conversation list's last line, a quote of one and a notification. Never the place itself.

location_coordinates.description: The place on a location card, in degrees with the decimal comma; latitude and longitude are location_north/location_south and location_east/location_west (docs/decisions/0059).

location_north.description: A latitude north of the equator; degrees is like 64,14196 (docs/decisions/0059).

location_south.description: A latitude south of the equator (docs/decisions/0059).

location_accuracy.description: How close the fix is, in whole metres, on the card and in the send dialog (docs/decisions/0059).

location_send_title.description: Heading of the dialog that asks before a location is sent; its buttons are send and cancel (docs/decisions/0059).

location_finding.description: While the phone takes a fresh fix, for up to 30 seconds (docs/decisions/0059).

location_not_found.description: No fix within 30 seconds, or location is off on the phone (docs/decisions/0059).

location_denied.description: The person refused location to the app; it can be allowed in the phone's settings (docs/decisions/0059).

camera_denied.description: The person refused the camera to the app; it can be allowed in the phone's settings, or a photo picked with the + menu instead (#323).

location_open_map_is.description: Opens the place on map.is in the browser; offered only inside Iceland's area (docs/decisions/0059).

location_open_maps.description: Opens the place in the phone's map app (docs/decisions/0059).

location_usage.description: Why the app asks for location, shown by iOS in its permission prompt (NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription, docs/decisions/0059).

person_unnamed.description: Stands in for an account whose name the server has not given, in titles and rows (docs/decisions/0022).

photo.description: Label of a photo message, in the conversation list and for screen readers.

file.description: Label of a file message, in the conversation list and for screen readers.

media_too_large.description: A chosen photo or file is over the limit (docs/decisions/0023).

media_download_failed.description: A photo or file could not be fetched or did not match its checksum; the bubble offers try_again.

file_no_app.description: A received file was opened, but no app on the device opens its type.

copy.description: Message menu entry that copies a text message to the clipboard (docs/decisions/0046).

copied.description: Brief confirmation that a message was copied, where the system shows none (docs/decisions/0046).

link_open.description: Screen-reader action on a message that opens one of its web links in the browser; link is the link as written (docs/decisions/0046).

edited_marker.description: Marker on a message that was edited.

delete_for_everyone.description: Delete an own message on every member's devices.

delete_confirm.description: Confirmation before deleting an own message for everyone.

message_deleted.description: Tombstone left where a deleted message was.

forwarded_marker.description: Mark above a forwarded message or a re-shared post, in place of its original sender (docs/decisions/0041).

forward.description: Message menu entry that copies a message into other conversations; also the title of the conversation picker it opens (docs/decisions/0041).

forward_done.description: Brief confirmation after a forward: into how many conversations it was sent (docs/decisions/0041).

pick_empty.description: The conversation picker when there is no conversation to send into.

post_share_done.description: Brief confirmation after a post was sent into conversations from its Deila sheet: into how many (docs/decisions/0080).

post_shared.description: A shared Fljótið post in the conversation list and in a notification: fixed, never the post's text or author (docs/decisions/0040).

item_unreadable.description: A stored message the core cannot read back, shown in its place in the conversation and as the list's last line, with its code under it (docs/decisions/0051). Never says more.

post_gone.description: The card of a shared post the server no longer shows: deleted, its author's account deleted, or its author blocked. It does not say which (docs/decisions/0040).

react.description: Add a reaction to a message.

react_any.description: The "+" at the end of a long press's emoji row, and the title of the sheet with every emoji it opens (docs/decisions/0072).

more.description: The last slot of the long-press bar when not every action fits; it opens a sheet with the rest (docs/decisions/0072).

reactions_title.description: Title of the sheet listing who reacted to a message (docs/decisions/0045).

reaction_count.description: Screen-reader text of a bubble's reaction pill: how many reactions it holds (docs/decisions/0045).

reactions_show.description: Screen-reader action on a bubble: open the sheet of who reacted (docs/decisions/0045).

reaction_remove_hint.description: Under the reader's own row in the reactions sheet: tapping it removes the reaction (docs/decisions/0045).

disappearing_messages.description: Per-conversation setting: messages delete themselves after a set time.

disappearing_set_card.description: System card when a member sets the disappearing timer; duration is formatted by the client.

disappearing_off_card.description: System card when a member turns the disappearing timer off.

disappearing_off.description: Timer option: messages do not disappear.

disappearing_option.description: Timer option label; duration is one of the duration keys below (docs/decisions/0022).

mute.description: Conversation menu item, and the title over its durations: no push and no notification for this conversation (docs/decisions/0042).

mute_always.description: Mute duration: until the person turns notifications back on.

unmute.description: Conversation menu item while it is muted: notifications come again.

muted.description: What a screen reader says for the muted mark beside the time in a conversation list row.

duration_hours.description: A duration in hours, in the form that follows "eftir" in disappearing_set_card and disappearing_option.

duration_days.description: A duration in days, in the form that follows "eftir" in disappearing_set_card and disappearing_option.

read_marker.description: Marker on an own message the other party has read.

read_by_count.description: Under an own message in a group: how many members have read it (docs/decisions/0022).

read_receipts_setting.description: Toggle in Me: send read markers.

read_receipts_hint.description: Explains that the read-marker toggle is reciprocal.

typing_setting.description: Toggle in Me: send typing indicators.

typing_indicator.description: Shown while another member is typing.

typing_indicator_group.description: Shown while a member of a group is typing; a group's typing frame does not prove who sent it, so it names no one (docs/decisions/0022).

unblock.description: Unblock a person, from the blocked list (docs/decisions/0024).

blocked_title.description: Heading of the list of blocked people on "Ég" (docs/decisions/0024).

blocked_empty.description: The blocked list when it is empty.

delete_account_confirm.description: Confirmation before deleting the account; says what the server deletes and what it cannot.

sign_in_hint.description: Under the sign-in button: what Google is asked for, and that Kenni can verify later.

sign_in_google.description: Primary sign-in button: signs in with Google (docs/decisions/0033).

verify_title.description: Heading of the screen that links Kenni to the account (docs/decisions/0033).

verify_body.description: What verifying with Kenni gives the person.

verify_point_name.description: Verify screen: the registry name replaces the account's name.

verify_point_kennitala.description: Verify screen: the kennitala is kept only as an HMAC (docs/decisions/0019).

verify_point_older.description: Point on the verify screen: a kennitala that already holds an older account takes this sign-in to it, with its conversations (docs/decisions/0035).

verify_action.description: Verify screen: opens Kenni to link it to the account.

verify_cta.description: On Ég and in settings for an account Kenni has not verified: opens the verify screen.

verify_linked.description: Web verify page, after Kenni linked to this account: the name now carries the mark (docs/decisions/0069).

verify_merged.description: Web verify page, after Kenni joined this sign-in into the older account its kennitala held (docs/decisions/0035, 0069).

photo_choose.description: On Ég for an account with no profile photo: opens the photo picker to set one (docs/decisions/0039).

photo_change.description: On Ég for an account with a profile photo: opens the photo picker to put another in its place (docs/decisions/0039).

photo_remove.description: On Ég: removes the profile photo, after a confirmation; also that confirmation's button (docs/decisions/0039).

photo_remove_confirm.description: Asks before the profile photo is removed: it goes for everyone (docs/decisions/0039).

photo_seen_by_all.description: The one line beside the photo buttons on Ég: every signed-in account sees the profile photo, which is not end-to-end encrypted (docs/decisions/0039).

delete.description: Deletes one's own post or reply, in its menu and its confirmation.

identity_taken.description: Kenni verified a person whose kennitala is on another account (409 identity_taken).

error_unreachable.description: The server could not be reached; the action can be tried again.

error_generic.description: Something failed that the person cannot fix but may retry.

problem_request_id.description: Small secondary line under a refusal naming the server's request id (decision 0037), so a tester can quote it.

problem_local_code.description: Small secondary line under a failure no server answered, naming the core's code for it (decision 0049), so a tester can quote it.

try_again.description: Button that repeats the action that failed.

cancel.description: Dismisses a confirmation without doing anything.

back.description: Screen-reader label of the back arrow at the top of a screen.

more_options.description: Screen-reader label of the conversation's menu button (the disappearing timer, block).

share.description: Shares the invite link through the system share sheet.

devices_title.description: Heading of the list of the account's devices on "Ég".

device_this.description: Marks the device the person is holding in the device list.

device_added.description: When a device was signed in, under its name in the device list.

device_revoke.description: Signs a device out of the account (DELETE /v1/devices/{id}).

device_revoke_confirm.description: Confirmation before signing a device out; says what it stops.

sign_out.description: Button on Ég that signs this device out, as revoking it does (docs/decisions/0047).

sign_out_confirm.description: Confirmation before signing this device out (docs/decisions/0047).

residency_claim.description: The only permitted statement about where data lives (docs/decisions/0001).

app_version.description: The app's and the core's version, at the foot of the settings, for a bug report.

onboarding_photo_title.description: Title of the first-launch photo step (docs/decisions/0043).

onboarding_photo_body.description: Body of the first-launch photo step; the photo is seen by every signed-in account and is not end-to-end encrypted (0039, 0043).

onboarding_continue.description: Moves to the next first-launch step once a photo is set (0043).

notifications_priming_title.description: Title of the first-launch step shown before the system notification prompt (0043).

notifications_priming_body.description: Body of the notification priming step; why notifications are asked for (0043).

notifications_enable.description: On the priming step: shows the system notification prompt (0043).

not_now.description: Skips the notification priming step without asking (0043).

find_people.description: On the empty conversation list: opens the new-conversation picker, where everyone signed in is listed (0036, 0043).

typing_in_row.description: Replaces a conversation row's preview while someone in it is typing; names no one (0022, 0043).

conversation_info.description: Screen-reader label of the conversation title, which opens its members, mute and timer (0043).

pick_search.description: Placeholder of the search field on the forward and share picker (0038, 0043).

pick_none_found.description: The forward and share picker when its search finds nothing (0043).

loading.description: Screen-reader text of the placeholder rows shown on a first load (0043).

mute_off.description: The state under the mute row of a conversation's information screen when it is not muted (0055).

muted_until.description: The state under the notifications row of a conversation's information screen while it is muted for a while; time is the clock time it ends (0042, 0055).

muted_always.description: The state under the notifications row of a conversation's information screen while it is muted until turned back on (0042, 0055).

shared_media.description: Heading over the photos and files sent in a conversation, on its information screen (0055).

shared_media_empty.description: The information screen when no photo or file has been sent in the conversation (0055).

sign_in_title.description: Heading of the web's sign-in page (decision 0062).

settings_title.description: The web's settings page: its heading and its link in the navigation.

main_navigation.description: Accessible name of the web's main navigation.

sessions_title.description: Heading of the list of sessions (decision 0061).

sessions_hint.description: Line under the sessions heading: what the list is.

session_this.description: Marks the session in the list that is this browser.

session_browser.description: A browser session in the list: its browser and system, as the server named them.

session_browser_unknown.description: A browser session whose browser the server could not name.

session_android.description: A session of the Android app in the list.

session_ios.description: A session of the iOS app in the list.

session_last_seen.description: When a browser session was last used, to the day.

session_signed_in.description: When an app's session signed in.

session_end.description: Button on another session in the list: signs that session out.

session_end_confirm.description: Confirmation before signing another browser out.

sessions_end_others.description: Button: signs out every session but this browser.

sessions_end_others_confirm.description: Confirmation before signing out every other session; says that an app's device is signed out with it.

photo_own_alt.description: Alternative text of the person's own photo.

photo_upload_failed.description: A photo upload was refused: too large or not an image (decision 0039).

reload_required.description: The web build is below the version floor (decision 0030).

reload.description: Button that reloads the web page.

tab_communities.description: Navigation: the communities a person is in and the way to find more (decision 0063).

communities_tab_feed.description: Tab of the community hub: the chronological feed of the posts in the person's communities (decision 0079).

communities_tab_mine.description: Tab of the community hub: the communities the person is a member of.

communities_tab_discover.description: Tab of the community hub: the search and the list of communities to join.

notifications_title.description: The notifications screen's title, and the name the bell in the top bar is read out by: what was addressed to this account in communities (decisions 0067, 0109).

notifications_unread.description: The count on the bell in the top bar, read out with it: how many notifications are unread (decision 0109).

notifications_empty.description: The notifications list when there is none.

notice_comment.description: A notification: someone commented on the reader's post. {name} is that person's name.

notice_reaction.description: A notification: someone reacted to the reader's post.

notice_join_approved.description: A notification: a moderator approved the reader's request to join a private community.

notice_moderated.description: A notification: a moderator hid or removed the reader's post or comment (decision 0063).

notice_reply.description: A notification: someone replied to the reader's comment on a post (decision 0103). {name} is that person's name.

notice_comment_two.description: A notification: two people commented on the reader's post (0103). {name} is the newest, {other} the other.

notice_comment_many.description: A notification: three or more people commented on the reader's post (0103). {name} is the newest; count is how many others.

notice_reply_two.description: A notification: two people replied to the reader's comment (0103). {name} is the newest, {other} the other.

notice_reply_many.description: A notification: three or more people replied to the reader's comment (0103). {name} is the newest; count is how many others.

notice_reaction_two.description: A notification: two people reacted to the reader's post (0103). {name} is the newest, {other} the other.

notice_reaction_many.description: A notification: three or more people reacted to the reader's post (0103). {name} is the newest; count is how many others.

notice_snippet.description: The quoted start of the comment or post a notification is about, under its sentence (decision 0105). {text} is that text, already shortened.

notice_section_new.description: Heading over the notifications that came since the list was last opened (decision 0104).

notice_section_earlier.description: Heading over the notifications the reader had already seen (decision 0104).

notifications_mark_all_read.description: Action in the notifications header: marks every notification read (decision 0104).

notice_menu.description: Accessible label of a notification's menu button (decision 0104).

notice_menu_read.description: Notification menu item: mark it read (decision 0104).

notice_menu_unread.description: Notification menu item: mark it unread again (decision 0104).

notice_menu_remove.description: Notification menu item: remove it from the list (decision 0104).

notice_menu_kind_in_app.description: Notification menu item: notifications of this kind stop reaching the phone and stay in the app (decision 0106).

notice_menu_community_off.description: Notification menu item: no more notifications from this community (decision 0106).

notification_settings_title.description: Heading of the notifications section in Settings, and the community menu item that opens its level (decision 0106).

notification_settings_body.description: Under the notifications heading in Settings: what the levels mean (decision 0106).

notification_settings_communities.description: Heading over the communities whose level the reader has changed (decision 0106).

notification_kind_comment.description: Notification settings row: comments on the reader's posts (decision 0106).

notification_kind_reply.description: Notification settings row: replies to the reader's comments (decision 0106).

notification_kind_reaction.description: Notification settings row: reactions to the reader's posts (decision 0106).

notification_kind_join_approved.description: Notification settings row: approved requests to join a community (decision 0106).

notification_kind_moderated.description: Notification settings row: a moderator's action on the reader's post or comment (decision 0106).

notification_moderated_floor.description: Under the moderators' row in notification settings: it can be quieted, never turned off (decisions 0067, 0106).

notification_level_push.description: Notification level: in the app and on the phone (decision 0106).

notification_level_in_app.description: Notification level: in the app only, no push (decision 0106).

person_deleted.description: Shown in place of the name of an account that was deleted.

communities_mine.description: Heading of the communities the person is a member of.

communities_empty.description: The person's community list when it is empty.

communities_find.description: Label of the search for communities by name.

communities_feed_empty.description: The hub's feed when the person's communities have no posts yet (decision 0079).

community_create.description: Heading and button: create a new community.

community_preview.description: Label of the live preview of the community header beside the create form on an expanded window (decision 0087).

community_name.description: Label of a community's name field.

community_description.description: Label of a community's description field.

community_open.description: A community anyone signed in may read and join (decision 0063).

community_private.description: A community only members read; joining takes approval (decision 0063).

community_open_hint.description: Explains an open community where it is chosen.

community_private_hint.description: Explains a private community where it is chosen.

community_members.description: How many members a community has.

community_members_title.description: Heading over a community's member list.

community_role_owner.description: A member's role: the one owner, who names moderators and may delete the community (decision 0063).

community_role_moderator.description: A member's role: approves join requests and moderates posts and comments (decision 0063).

community_role_member.description: A member's role: reads, posts, comments and reacts (decision 0063).

community_make_moderator.description: Owner action on a member: make them a moderator.

community_remove_moderator.description: Owner action on a moderator: take the role away.

community_info.description: Title of the screen with a community's full description, its hosting notice and its members (decision 0079).

community_read_more.description: Link that opens the full description from the feed's clamped community description (decision 0079).

community_not_encrypted_notice.description: Says a community's content is hosted on a server and is not end-to-end encrypted (decisions 0060, 0063).

wall_not_encrypted_notice.description: Says a wall's content is hosted on a server and is not end-to-end encrypted (decision 0115).

wall_tab_posts.description: The tab of a wall's posts (decision 0115).

wall_tab_about.description: The tab of a wall's bio and joined month (decision 0115).

wall_tab_images.description: The tab of the images in the wall's posts the viewer may read (decision 0115).

wall_bio_label.description: The label of the short text an account writes about itself (decision 0115).

wall_bio_placeholder.description: The placeholder of the bio field (decision 0115).

wall_bio_too_long.description: Says the bio is longer than the limit (decision 0115).

wall_joined.description: When the account joined, its month and year (decision 0115).

wall_cover_alt.description: The alt text of an account's cover (decision 0115).

wall_audience_label.description: The label of the audience picker on a wall post (decision 0115).

wall_audience_friends.description: The audience of a wall post that only the owner's friends read (decision 0115).

wall_audience_everyone.description: The audience of a wall post that every signed-in account reads (decision 0115).

wall_comment_remove.description: The owner's action of removing a comment from their wall (decision 0115).

wall_comment_remove_confirm.description: The confirmation of removing a comment from one's wall (decision 0115).

wall_comment_remove_reason.description: The label of the reason asked of an owner removing a comment (decision 0115).

moderation_report_on_wall.description: Marks a report in the platform's queue as being of a wall's content (decision 0115).

moderation_decision_clear_account_bio.description: The logged decision of clearing an account's bio (decision 0115).

platform_review_not_yours.description: Why the buttons are off on a review the viewer acted on or asked for.

platform_review_text_gone.description: A review whose text was purged after its 90 days: it is decided without it (decision 0115).

platform_review_decider.description: Label of who acted, shown only to the deciding platform moderator.

moderation_log_review_upheld.description: A log entry: a review upheld an action.

moderation_log_review_overturned.description: A log entry: a review overturned an action.

post_tombstone_open.description: Link from a removed post to reading it, for a moderator of its community.

notice_account_suspended.description: A notification: a platform moderator suspended the reader's account (decision 0115).

notice_account_unsuspended.description: A notification: a platform moderator lifted the suspension of the reader's account (decision 0115).

moderation_decision_suspend_account.description: The decision recorded when a platform moderator suspends an account (decision 0115).

moderation_decision_suspend_account_unti.description: What a statement, the log and a review card say of a suspension decided with an end date (decision 0115).

moderation_decision_suspend_account_open.description: What a statement, the log and a review card say of a suspension decided with no end date: it stands until a moderator lifts it (decision 0115).

moderation_decision_unsuspend_account.description: The decision recorded when a platform moderator lifts a suspension (decision 0115).

platform_suspend.description: The platform moderator's action: suspend the reported account (decision 0115).

platform_suspend_confirm.description: Confirmation before the platform moderator suspends an account.

platform_unsuspend.description: The platform moderator's action: lift the suspension of the reported account (decision 0115).

platform_unsuspend_confirm.description: Confirmation before the platform moderator lifts a suspension.

platform_suspend_open.description: The duration a suspension has when it has no end date; beside the mute durations.

problem_suspended.description: The server refused a write because the account is suspended, with no end date (decision 0115).

problem_suspended_until.description: The server refused a write because the account is suspended until the date (decision 0115).

suspended_notice.description: The notice a suspended account sees on every signed-in screen, with no end date (decision 0115).

suspended_notice_until.description: The notice a suspended account sees on every signed-in screen, with the end date (decision 0115).

statement_review_overturned_lifted.description: A statement's review of a suspension: overturned, and the suspension lifted (decision 0115).

statement_review_overturned_later_stands.description: A statement's review of a suspension: overturned, but a later suspension stands (decision 0115).

person_add_friend.description: Button on a person screen: ask this person to be friends (decision 0114).

person_request_sent.description: Button state on a person screen: a friend request stands. It reads the same whatever the other person did with it (decision 0114).

person_answer_request.description: Button on a person screen: this person asked to be friends; opens accept and decline (decision 0114).

person_friends.description: Button state on a person screen, and the title of the own list of friends (decision 0114).

person_decline.description: Decline a friend request. The sender is not told.

person_cancel_request.description: Take back a friend request the reader sent.

friend_end.description: End a friendship, from a person screen.

friend_end_confirm.description: Confirmation before ending a friendship. {name} is the other person.

person_friends_since.description: How long two people have been friends. {date} is a formatted date.

person_mutual_heading.description: Heading of the friends the reader and this person have in common.

person_shared_communities.description: Heading of the communities the reader and this person are both in.

person_snooze.description: Hide this person's posts from the reader's feed for 30 days. Nobody is told.

person_snoozed_until.description: How long a person stays hidden. {date} is a formatted date.

friends_incoming.description: Heading of the friend requests to the reader.

friends_sent.description: Heading of the friend requests from the reader that still stand.

friends_snoozed.description: Heading of the people whose posts the reader has hidden for now.

friends_empty.description: The own list of friends is empty.

friends_search_empty.description: A name search of the own friends found nobody.

friends_sort_label.description: Label of the sort control of the own friends.

friends_sort_newest.description: Sort friends by the newest friendship.

notice_friend_request.description: A notification: someone asked the reader to be friends. {name} is that person.

notice_reports_waiting.description: A notification to a platform moderator: reports wait in the platform queue (decision 0115). Names no count, reporter or target.

notice_friend_accepted.description: A notification: someone accepted the reader's friend request. {name} is that person.

notification_kind_friend_request.description: Notification settings row: friend requests to the reader (decision 0114).

notification_kind_friend_accepted.description: Notification settings row: the reader's friend requests accepted (decision 0114).

problem_request_refused.description: The server refused a friend request. It never says why: a decline is not disclosed (decision 0114).

problem_request_limit.description: The server refused a friend request: too many in 24 hours.

problem_friend_limit.description: The server refused a friendship: one of the two has the most friends one may have.

person_friend_count.description: How many friends a person has.

person_mutual_count.description: How many friends the reader and this person have in common.
